scoring_justification: Lattice energies are recomputed from agent's ion volumes using the Jenkins formulas, then compared to paper gold (±5 kJ mol⁻¹); cation volume R² against experimental volumes also recomputed.

outputs.description: Contains the computed anion volume, cation volumes for cations 1-9, and the lattice energies, enthalpies, and free energies for each salt. The checker will recompute lattice energies from the submitted volumes and compare against hidden reference values; it will also compute the R² between submitted cation volumes and hidden experimental cation volumes.

output_contract.notes: The checker uses the Jenkins formulas (1)-(3) from the paper to recalculate lattice energies from the submitted ion volumes. It compares the recalculated energies against hidden paper gold values and also checks the correlation between submitted and experimental cation volumes. No pass threshold is given here; scoring is based on tolerances and correlation criteria hidden in the grading specification.

hidden_assets.purpose: paper Table 1 lattice energies and experimental cation volumes
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from Table 1 of the paper (10.1021/cg060746u)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Paper-reported values in Table 1 are the published gold; no synthetic data.

steps.description: Validate that computed_results.json exists and contains the required top-level keys and at least one entry per cation.
Recompute UL, dHL, dGL from ion volumes and compare to paper gold; each of the 27 individual energy comparisons must be within ±5 kJ mol⁻¹.
Compute R² between the submitted cation volumes and the paper's experimental cation volumes; must be ≥ 0.97 to pass.
